descripcion: Installs Google Play services (Play Store, Play Services) on the instance.
queToca: downloads a package from an external server (not controlled by this project)
registers an Android ID (GSF) that has to be registered by hand at https://www.google.com/android/uncertified within 48 hours of the first boot, or Google blocks GApps access on that instance

es.descripcion: Instala servicios de Google Play (Play Store, Play Services) en la instancia.
queToca: descarga un paquete de un servidor externo (no controlado por este proyecto)
registra un Android ID (GSF) que hay que dar de alta a mano en https://www.google.com/android/uncertified dentro de las 48hs del primer boot, o Google bloquea el acceso a GApps en esa instancia
